content.title: 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline
key_points: The guideline provides recommendations for aortic disease management.
It highlights the importance of biometric markers in improving outcome predictions for aortic aneurysms.
Cost-effectiveness analyses are included for various treatment strategies involving aortic aneurysms.
Emerging therapies, including medicinal and lifestyle interventions, are discussed.
